source_policy: Primary references support definitions and stated conditions. Scenarios and worked derivations are originally authored constructions. The supplied book matrix guides sequencing; it is not independent verification of exact-edition book coverage.
purpose: Compare two changes in packing time and see interaction as nonparallel responses.
meaning: Two factors interact on an additive response scale when the effect of one depends on the level of the other. A difference of differences compares those two simple effects. The conventional ±1 factorial interaction effect is half this explicitly named contrast.

definition.setting: A constructed packing experiment combines a tool (off/on) and a guide (off/on). Mean packing times are 12, 10, 9 and c minutes in the four cells. Compare the tool effect with and without the guide.

signature.c: Mean time with both tool and guide.
signature.Δ: Difference between the two tool effects, in minutes.

conditions: A constructed packing experiment combines a tool (off/on) and a guide (off/on). Mean packing times are 12, 10, 9 and c minutes in the four cells. Compare the tool effect with and without the guide.
